data.title: Remnants of Polo (EP2), advisory 30/0233Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: POLO DISSIPATES OVER NORTHWESTERN MEXICO. As of 8:00 PM MST Tue Sep 29 the center of Polo was located near 30.5, -108.0 with movement NE at 23 mph. The minimum central pressure was 996 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 35 mph.

data.title: Tropical Depression Nineteen-E (EP4), advisory 30/0233Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: TROPICAL DEPRESSION NINETEEN WEAKENS. As of 8:00 PM PDT Tue Sep 29 the center of Nineteen-E was located near 13.8, -130.2 with movement ESE at 9 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1006 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 30 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Rachel (EP3), advisory 30/0234Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: RACHEL EXPECTED TO BECOME A HURRICANE SOON. ...TROPICAL STORM CONDITIONS OCCURRING WITHIN THE WARNING AREA ALONG THE SOUTHWESTERN COAST OF MEXICO... As of 8:00 PM MST Tue Sep 29 the center of Rachel was located near 17.0, -106.6 with movement NW at 13 mph. The minimum central pressure was 989 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 70 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Hanna (AT3), advisory 30/0234Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: HANNA HOLDING STEADY WHILE MAINTAINING A SOUTHEASTWARD TRACK. As of 3:00 AM GMT Wed Sep 30 the center of Hanna was located near 33.7, -43.6 with movement SE at 12 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1005 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 40 mph.
